explanation: David income: 8% of x = 800 => x = 10000. Wife income: 8% of y = 840 => y = 10500. After raise: David = 10800, Wife = 11340. Difference = 11340 - 10800 = 540. Wait: original difference = 500, new difference with 8% raise each = 500 + 8% of 500 = 540. Answer: Rs. 540.

text: A company bought a total of 60 computers and 20 printers to modernise billing operations. If the price of each computer was three times the price of each printer, what percent of the total cost was the total cost of the printers?
explanation: Let printer price = p. Computer = 3p. Total cost = 60(3p) + 20p = 180p + 20p = 200p. Printer cost = 20p. Percentage = (20p/200p) × 100 = 10%. Answer: 10%.

explanation: Tax = 30% of income. Surcharge = 10% of tax = 10% of 30% = 3%. Total = 30 + 3 = 33%. Answer: 33%.
